scope: Same-origin two-window controlled DOM; real abstract sessions; synthetic origin denial and malformed inputs explicitly labelled. Browser/assistive hardware separate.

checks.name: All 43 exercise sessions retain exactly the same commands, outcome and checkpoint with descriptions
Disabled text consumes only its private cursor and never displays past events on activation
Manual actions at the same frame are observed once, without advancing time
Context phase labels describe a simulation, not a boss death or campaign victory
UV activation is specific to the only exercise that supports the apparatus
Restoring a copied checkpoint opens a new observation, not a replay of historical notices
Synthetic event-window overflow is labelled partial without inventing an exact missed count
Synthetic volume is bounded to 60 entries and two current lines; expiry freezes in pause
Unknown and HTML-looking context events are not promoted to live official dialogue
Rejected action notices preserve their reason and never imply energy or progress was gained
Context panel pauses a playing session and restores it without a new clock or storage write
Context modal contains keyboard focus and blocks manual action shortcuts behind it
Context selection and reset clear old history; invalid import preserves the active journal
Blur/visibility and finished sessions do not auto-resume when the context panel closes
All 43 context selectors keep the read-only panel available without rewards from consultation
Dossier parent samples only the exact acknowledged same-origin duel
Story text panel preserves the running pause state, focus, saves and progression counters
Story pause and blur interruptions never gain a resume from closing text
Changing story while text is open closes it and cannot revive its old duel
Mismatched child token or foreign-origin access fails closed without throwing or game writes
Invalid result packets and unsolicited messages cannot fill the story text journal or grant a win
A real accelerated story duel still delivers one result with no extra win from text
Context result has one live announcement source, with the existing fallback restored when text is disabled
Story input held before opening the panel is released instead of replayed on close
All historical data, original assets, simulations and three contracts remain unchanged
